User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the LIVENET platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user (matches Firebase Auth UID).

profilePicture.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

bio.description: A short biography of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

coverUrl.description: URL of the user's cover media (image or video).

coverType.description: The type of media used for the cover.

Broadcast.title: Broadcast
Broadcast.description: Represents a single live stream session on the platform.

hostId.description: The ID of the user hosting the broadcast. Links to the User entity.

hostName.description: Denormalized username of the host for quick display.

hostAvatar.description: Denormalized URL of the host's avatar for quick display.

tags.description: A list of tags for discoverability.

isLive.description: Indicates if the broadcast is currently active.

viewerCount.description: An approximate count of current viewers.

createdAt.description: The server timestamp when the broadcast was created.

challenge.description: An initial challenge or topic for the stream, often set at creation.

activeChallenge.description: The current challenge or prompt being displayed on stream, can be updated live.

activeChallengeType.description: The type of the active challenge, used for UI styling.

challengeStartTime.description: The server timestamp when the active challenge was started.

challengeDurationSeconds.description: The duration in seconds for the active challenge.

x.description: The x-coordinate of the challenge card.

y.description: The y-coordinate of the challenge card.

challengeCardPosition.description: The position of the draggable challenge card on the screen.

width.description: The width of the challenge card.

height.description: The height of the challenge card.

challengeCardSize.description: The size of the resizable challenge card on the screen.

streamDetails.description: Holds dynamic details about the live stream session.

isScreenSharing.description: True if the host is currently sharing their screen.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message in a broadcast chat.

userId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

message.description: The content of the chat message.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp when the message was created.

replyingTo.description: The username of the user being replied to.

Reaction.title: Reaction
Reaction.description: Represents a single real-time reaction from a viewer.

senderId.description: The ID of the user who sent the reaction.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp, used for TTL policy and ordering.

Guest.title: Guest
Guest.description: Represents a guest who has been invited to or joined a broadcast.

userId.description: The ID of the guest user.

status.description: The current status of the guest in the broadcast.

Like.title: Like
Like.description: Represents a user's 'like' on a broadcast.

userId.description: The ID of the user who liked the broadcast.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of when the like occurred.

Follow.title: Follow
Follow.description: Represents a follow relationship between two users.

userId.description: The ID of the user initiating the follow.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of when the follow occurred.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents an in-app notification for a user.

userId.description: The ID of the user who receives the notification.

actorId.description: The ID of the user who triggered the notification.

actorName.description: The denormalized username of the actor for display.

actorAvatar.description: The denormalized avatar URL of the actor for display.

entityId.description: The ID of the related entity (e.g., a broadcastId).

entityInfo.description: A short descriptive string about the entity (e.g., a broadcast title or comment snippet).

isRead.description: Whether the user has read the notification.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp when the notification was created.

definition.description: Stores public user profile information. The userId is equal to the Firebase Authentication UID.
Core document for a live stream. Contains metadata about the session.
Sub-collection storing chat messages for a specific broadcast.
Sub-collection for ephemeral real-time reactions. Documents should have a TTL policy.
Sub-collection managing the state of guests (co-hosts) for a broadcast.
Sub-collection storing likes for a broadcast. The document ID is the UID of the user who liked it.
Sub-collection where each document represents a user that {userId} is following. The document ID is the UID of the user being followed.
Sub-collection where each document represents a user that is following {userId}. The document ID is the UID of the follower.
Sub-collection storing notifications for a specific user.

firestore.reasoning: This Firestore structure is designed for a scalable and feature-rich live streaming application. It uses a root `broadcasts` collection for discoverability and nests ephemeral or stream-specific data like chat, reactions, likes, and guests in sub-collections. User profiles are kept in a separate root collection to avoid data duplication and to house user-specific sub-collections like `following` and `followers`. Denormalization of host information on the `Broadcast` document optimizes for read-heavy client scenarios, reducing the need for extra lookups.
